notes: Three מִן tokens against two written *from*s plus one *more than*: the first takes *from these*, the comparative takes *more than from* (the *from* standing before the phrase it governs), and the third, before הַתִּכֹנוֹת, is unrepresented (rules 22, 25).
*took away* is one lexical verb with a phrasal particle, so the head stays on *took* (rule 44), and the supplied *the* before *galleries* belongs to that noun under rule 15.
